correctness.rationale: Fixed-rank square-zero A has a standard three-block normal form, and the annihilation equations restrict B to the stated upper-block form. Multiplication gives precisely XZ²=0, Z²H=0, Z³=0, XZH=0. Size-three Jordan chains are killed by the first two constraints, size-one chains vanish, and only the v size-two chains generate the rectangular equation X₂H₂=0; a rank-stratified surjection count yields H_{r,v}. Nilpotent Jordan centralizer and orbit-stabilizer formulas count each Z exactly once; Gaussian counts enumerate every labeled A exactly once. Boundary ranks and the empty dimension are covered; the direct-matrix checker agrees for eight (n,q) cases.

value.rationale: V(n,2,3) is the first asymmetrically truncated Gelfand–Ponomarev family after the radical-square-zero case, a natural finite-dimensional representation variety already studied geometrically. The count supplies the complete rational-point sequence for all dimensions and finite fields, not an arbitrary fixed-size table. Its nontrivial structural reduction singles out the size-two Jordan-block multiplicity v as the sole residual bilinear obstruction, enabling exact evaluation with no orbit classification. The n=3 polynomial and its strict excess over simultaneous square-zero bounds illustrate a concrete new arithmetic invariant.
